`PackedScene` creates a callable for the `SetupMenu` receiver using each stored `method` string. `SetupMenu` defines `map_editor_requested` and `cancelled` as signals, not methods, so pressing either button cannot emit the intended signal.

+[connection signal="pressed" from="Panel/Content/EditorButton" to="." method="_on_editor_pressed"]
+[connection signal="pressed" from="Panel/Content/BackButton" to="." method="_on_back_pressed"]
